text: Even on the path of Thy judgments, O Lord, we trust in Thee

tail: ; O Thou, longing of our heart, in adversity we search for Thee; pure of heart, we appeared already yesterday before Thee, even before sounding the tone of the Shofar. By decree didst Thou decide from the original creation to appoint repentance as the first of Thy pronouncements; even before the first judgment was arranged, repentance was already there to save sinners from destruction. Thou who hast formed their two instincts together and seest and knowest their innermost thoughts, should a sin appear within their hiding places, Thou wilt surely bear their great ancestors in mind for them. Rem

ember him (Joseph) whose shoulder Thou didst relieve from the burden, who as a slave, was freed from the affliction of fetters; though his offsprings have erred through lust, may his purity save them in this life of vanity. As for the day hidden in Thy heart and the retribution at the end of days, bring about the gathering of the exiles, the day prepared for the end of seasons, that is awaited from year to year, from time to time. Reveal the hidden day, decide the month for the severed thorns (sinners) to be burnt and disappear, for the stumbling block to be removed from the crooked heart and
for Abraham, Isaac and Jacob to be remembered.
